options.name: aggregated
options.description: If true, send aggregated callhome logs, otherwise upload logs from each node

options.name: alt_s3_host_port
options.description: Specifies alternative S3 service host and port for upload. For example: 10.10.10.10:443.

options.name: aws_s3_ak
options.description: S3 Bucket access key

options.name: aws_s3_bucket_name
options.description: S3 Bucket for upload

options.name: aws_s3_bucket_subdir
options.description: Sub-Directory in support bucket

options.name: aws_s3_sk
options.description: S3 Bucket secret key

options.name: bundle_enabled
options.description: Set to true to enable periodic sending of bundles to the Support server (deprecated)

options.name: bundle_interval
options.description: The frequency for sending bundles to the Support server (deprecated)

options.name: clear_fields
options.description: List of fields to explicitly reset to null on the resource. Use this to clear an optional field back to its empty/unset state, which a plain parameter cannot express (an omitted parameter is ignored).

options.name: cloud_api_domain
options.description: Uplink API domain name

options.name: cloud_api_key
options.description: Uplink API key

options.name: cloud_enabled
options.description:
Set to true to enable reporting to Uplink, VAST's cloud-based SaaS that enables you to manage all VAST Clusters
deployed by your organization anywhere in the world through a single cloud portal.

options.name: cloud_subdomain
options.description: Uplink subdomain, unique per customer and shared by all clusters reporting to the customer's Uplink.

options.name: compress_method
options.description: Compression method for callhome bundles (by default zstd)

options.name: customer
options.description: Company name

options.name: customer_id
options.description: The ID issued to the customer

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: location
options.description: Site location

options.name: log_enabled
options.description: Set to true to enable system state data to be logged to the Support server

options.name: log_interval
options.description: The frequency for sending system state data to the Support server.

options.name: luna_analyze_period
options.description: Analyzed period size, minutes

options.name: luna_on_alarm_enabled
options.description: Enabled/disabled luna analyzing tool on specific alarms

options.name: luna_on_alarm_interval
options.description: Maximum allowed frequency in hours for alarm-triggered luna

options.name: max_upload_bandwidth
options.description: The maximum upload bandwidth in bytes.

options.name: max_upload_concurrency
options.description: The maximum number of parts of a file to upload simultaneously.

options.name: obfuscated
options.description: If true, call home data is obfuscated.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: Proxy IP/hostname

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Proxy password

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: Proxy Port

options.name: proxy_scheme
options.description: Proxy Scheme

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: Proxy username

options.name: site
options.description: Site name

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource (absent is not supported).

options.name: support_channel
options.description: Set to true to enable the VAST Support channel.

options.name: test_mode
options.description: Set to true to enable test mode

options.name: upload_via_vms
options.description: If true, upload non-aggregated Callhome Bundle via VMS (requires proxy). Otherwise, upload from each node.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description:
Set to true to enable SSL verification. Set to false to disable. VAST Cluster recognizes SSL certificates from a
large range of widely recognized certificate authorities (CAs). VAST Cluster may not recognize an SSL certificate
signed by your own in-house CA.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
